messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
बहुत से जानवर हैं जिनसे वह विवाह करती है, और अधिक अभी भी होंगे जब तक कुत्ता आएगा आएगा जो उसे शोक से मरवा देगा।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Molti | “many” (quantifier) | **बहुत से** | many (plural) | OK | | son | copular verb “are” | **हैं** | are | OK | | li | definite article “the” (masc. pl.) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | animali | “animals” (noun) | **जानवर** | animals | OK | | a | preposition “with” | **से** | with / from | OK | | cui | relative pronoun “which / whom” (object of *a*) | **जिनसे** | which (whom) | OK | | s'ammoglia | verb “wives” (causative) | **विवाह करती है** | she weds | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **और** | and | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | **अधिक** | more | OK | | saranno | future copula “shall be” | **होंगे** | shall be | OK | | ancora | adverb “still / yet” | **अभी भी** | still / yet | OK | | infin | subordinating conjunction “until” | **जब तक** | until | OK | | che (in “infin che”) | subordinator “that” (part of “until that”) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | ’l | definite article “the” (masc. sg.) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | veltro | noun “hound” | **कुत्ता** | hound | OK | | verrà | future verb “shall come” | **आएगा** | shall come | OK | | che (in “che la farà…”) | relative pronoun “that” | **जो** | that | OK | | la | pronoun “her” (acc.) | **उसे** | her | OK | | farà | causative verb “will make” | **देगा** | will make | OK | | morir | infinitive “to die” (as complement of causative) | **मरवा** | cause to die | OK | | con | preposition “of” (in “die of grief”) | **से** | of | OK | | doglia | noun “grief” | **शोक** | grief | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *li*, *che* (in “infin che”), *’l* – Italian articles or conjunctions that have no explicit counterpart in Hindi; they are naturally omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: बहुत से जानवर हैं जिनसे वह विवाह करती है, - Issue: none - Corrected: बहुत से जानवर हैं जिनसे वह विवाह करती है,
- Line 2: - Original: और अधिक अभी भी होंगे जब तक कुत्ता आएगा - Issue: none - Corrected: और अधिक अभी भी होंगे जब तक कुत्ता आएगा
- Line 3: - Original: आएगा जो उसे शोक से मरवा देगा। - Issue: none - Corrected: आएगा जो उसे शोक से मरवा देगा।
